title: FRAME INPUT I/O — Dial + Volume + Posts + Power = Own Controller
principle: The Frame has a dial for scroll, volume +/-, 2 posts (buttons), and power (press/hold). We can use this for input IO to the Frame INSTEAD and make it WAY MORE its own controller!

dial.device: event2: ALS31300 (Hall Effect magnetic rotary encoder!)
dial.type: 3-axis magnetic field sensor = SCROLL + TILT + ROTATION
dial.note: This is NOT a simple encoder — it reads magnetic field in 3D! Can detect rotation angle, tilt, and proximity of a magnet.
gaia_use: SCROLL: rotate through menus, lists, timelines
TILT: adjust layer depth, volume, brightness

volume_up.gaia_use: LAYER UP — navigate up through organism layers

volume_down.gaia_use: LAYER DOWN — navigate down through organism layers

actions.double_press: could be mapped to custom action

power_button.gaia_use: POWER/WAKE — bring GAIA's face to life

virtual_gamepad.note: SteamOS maps physical controls to virtual Xbox pad for game compatibility
virtual_gamepad.gaia_use: Full gamepad — navigation, games, spatial control

organism_control.dial_rotate: scroll through GAIA feeds, stories, art, data

als31300_3d_hall.note: The ALS31300 is a 3D Hall Effect sensor — it senses magnetic fields in X, Y, Z
implications: Can detect rotation of a MAGNET near it (not just clicking)
Can sense proximity of magnetic objects
Can detect compass heading if calibrated
Could detect nearby magnetic devices (phones, speakers)
Essentially: the dial is also a MAGNETIC FIELD SENSOR
